description: Core actions and cross-domain intents. Domain extensions live in data/domains/*.json.

examples: I'm looking for something like that
can you look up a few

retrieve.description: Fetch a specific, already-known item or its status.
examples: pull up the details of that one
show me mine for that day
how do they stack up against each other
is the first better than the second?
which should I choose between the two

summarize.description: Produce a shorter version of some content.
examples: shorten this into a brief overview

extract.description: Pull specific fields or values out of content.
examples: pull out the specific values from it
list every item mentioned in it
grab the fields from the text
get all of the entries out of this
copy out the numbers in it

create.description: Make something new: text, code, an event, a booking.

modify.description: Change, cancel or reformat something that already exists.

explain.description: Explain or answer a question about something.
examples: what is the reason for that
why am I getting an error
how do I solve this issue

plan.description: Produce a plan, schedule or itinerary.
examples: create a step by step plan
how should I prepare over the next few weeks
work out a plan for me
which category does this belong to
tag it with the right category
how do you say this in another language
what does this mean in English
convert this text into a different language

calculate.description: Compute a number, total or conversion.
examples: how much is it in total
what's the answer to this sum

other.description: A request whose concrete task is not stated yet.

intents.label: answer a general question
intents.description: Answer a factual or general-knowledge question, or explain a concept in plain language.
examples: Explain quantum computing in simple terms
Tell me about the French Revolution
Can you explain how compound interest works?
when did the first world war end
how far is the moon from earth
How many bones are in the human body?
Why do leaves change colour in autumn?
Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
What are the symptoms of dehydration?
How do solar panels generate electricity?
How does the human heart pump blood?
What language is spoken in Brazil?
How does a refrigerator keep food cold?
Is coffee bad for your health?
negative_examples: explain what this Python function does
search the web for the latest news about black holes
what's the difference between a virus and bacteria

intents.label: search the web
intents.description: Search the internet for current information, news, articles or web pages.
examples: Search the web for the latest news on electric cars
Google the release date of the next iPhone
Look up reviews of the new Batman movie online
find articles about climate change policy
What's the latest news about the stock market?
search online for vegetarian lasagna recipes
find me some blogs about minimalism
check what people are saying online about the new GTA game
browse the internet for remote work statistics
look up the latest updates on this topic
search online for information about it
find recent news articles on that
negative_examples: find Java developer jobs in Pune
find a cheap laptop under 40000
find the termination clause in this contract

intents.label: compare things
intents.description: Compare two or more things, options or concepts and explain their differences.
examples: What's the difference between a virus and bacteria?
Which is better for beginners, guitar or piano?
pros and cons of renting vs buying a house
how does living in Pune compare to Bangalore
SQL vs NoSQL, which should I use?
which of these options is cheaper
negative_examples: Compare iPhone 15 and Pixel 8
find a cheap laptop

intents.label: recommend something to read, watch or do
intents.description: Suggest books, movies, music, places, restaurants or activities.
examples: Suggest a good book to read this weekend
what are some good places to visit in Kerala?
any podcasts about history you'd recommend?
suggest a nice restaurant for a birthday dinner
what should I watch on Netflix
give me some hobby ideas for the weekend
negative_examples: recommend a laptop for video editing under 80000
plan a 3 day trip to Kerala

intents.label: translate text
intents.description: Translate text or a phrase from one natural language into another.
examples: How do you say 'thank you' in Japanese?
translate 'where is the station' to Spanish
Can you convert this paragraph from English to Hindi?
I need this email in German
translate the following text to Tamil
negative_examples: convert this JavaScript code to TypeScript
convert 5 miles to kilometers

parameters.name: target_language
parameters.question: Which language should it be translated into?

intents.label: calculate a value
intents.description: Do arithmetic, percentages, unit or currency conversion, loan or bill calculations.
examples: How much is 120 USD in INR?
Calculate the EMI for a 5 lakh loan at 9% interest for 3 years
how many days are there between March 3 and July 19
split a 2400 rupee bill between 3 people
negative_examples: convert this paragraph to Hindi
find laptops under 50000

intents.label: classify or label text
intents.description: Assign a category, label, sentiment or spam/not-spam judgement to some text.
examples: What's the sentiment of this review?
Categorize these support tickets by urgency
classify this news article into a topic
is this comment positive or negative
detect whether this message is toxic
which department should this complaint go to?

intents.label: chat
intents.description: Greetings, thanks, small talk and questions about the assistant itself.
negative_examples: can you help me with my phone

intents.label: get help (task not specified yet)
intents.description: A vague request for help that names a subject but not what should be done.
examples: Can you help me with something?
I need help with my phone
can you assist me with Java
I have a question about my account
could you help me out with a problem
I'm stuck with my project, can you help
negative_examples: help me write a cover letter
help me fix this KeyError in my code
thanks for your help
intents.always_clarify: Sure. What would you like me to do?

intents.label: summarize a document or text
intents.description: Summarize an article, document, email thread, notes or pasted text.
examples: Give me a short summary of the attached PDF
Can you condense these meeting notes into bullet points?
what are the key points of this document
give me the gist of this email thread
boil this paper down to 3 sentences
recap the main ideas from the chapter
too long, just tell me what it says
what's the gist of this email
I don't have time to read this whole thing
condense this long thread for me
what are the main points in this presentation
negative_examples: extract all the dates from this contract
rewrite this paragraph to be shorter

intents.label: extract information from a document
intents.description: Pull specific fields, values, tables or lists out of a document or text.
examples: Extract all the email addresses from this file
pull the dates and amounts out of these invoices
Get the table on page 4 of the PDF into a spreadsheet
list every person mentioned in this article
extract the key clauses from the contract
grab the invoice number and total from this receipt
parse the names and addresses from this document
get all the action items out of these meeting notes
negative_examples: summarize this contract
find the section about refunds in this policy

intents.label: write a document or message
intents.description: Write or draft new text: letters, emails, essays, posts, resumes, proposals, poems.
examples: Write a cover letter for a data analyst position
Draft an email to my manager asking for leave
Create a project proposal for a mobile app
write a blog post about remote work
compose a thank you note for my teacher
generate a product description for wireless earbuds
write a LinkedIn post announcing my new job
I need a formal letter to the bank to close my account
write a short poem about the monsoon
negative_examples: write a Python function to reverse a string
rewrite this email to sound more polite

intents.label: edit or rewrite existing text
intents.description: Rewrite, proofread, shorten, simplify or change the tone of existing text.
examples: Rewrite this paragraph to sound more professional
fix the grammar in my essay
this message sounds too harsh, soften it
change the tone of this message to friendly
edit my cover letter to remove repetition
improve the wording of this introduction
negative_examples: write a new cover letter for me
refactor this function

intents.label: find something inside a document
intents.description: Locate a section, clause, mention or passage inside a specific document or notes.
examples: Find the section about refunds in this policy
where does the contract mention termination?
search my notes for anything about the Q3 budget
which page talks about safety guidelines
look for the clause on late payment fees in the agreement
does this document say anything about remote work?
find all mentions of Acme Corp in the report
does the policy say anything about overtime?
where in this document is the warranty discussed
find the paragraph that talks about pricing
is there a mention of penalties in this agreement
look through my notes for what the client said about delivery
negative_examples: search the web for refund policies
extract all email addresses from this file

intents.label: open or fetch an existing record
intents.description: Open, show or fetch a specific existing item the user already has: a file, report, statement, calendar or notes.
examples: show me the Q3 sales report
get my bank statement for September
pull up the notes from yesterday's meeting
fetch the latest version of the design doc
show me my appointments this week
negative_examples: where is my order
summarize the Q3 sales report

intents.label: write code
intents.description: Write new code: functions, scripts, queries, regexes, components or tests.
examples: Write a Python function to reverse a string
generate a SQL query that finds duplicate emails
create a REST API endpoint in FastAPI for user login
code a binary search in Java
give me a bash script to rename all .txt files
I need a regex that matches Indian phone numbers
build a React component for a login form
write unit tests for this function
negative_examples: fix the bug in this Python function
explain what this function does
write a cover letter

intents.label: debug code
intents.description: Diagnose and fix errors, exceptions, failing builds or wrong behaviour in code.
examples: Why does my Python script throw a KeyError?
fix this bug in my JavaScript code
my React app shows a blank page after build
I'm getting NullPointerException in Java, help
this SQL query returns duplicate rows, what's wrong?
npm install fails with permission denied
segmentation fault in my C program
my code works locally but fails in Docker
TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined, how do I fix it
pip can't find the module even though I installed it
negative_examples: my wifi keeps disconnecting
write a Python function to parse dates

intents.label: explain code or a programming concept
intents.description: Explain what a piece of code, command, regex or programming concept does.
examples: walk me through this SQL query line by line
how does this recursive function work?
what is the purpose of async/await in JavaScript
what does the yield keyword do in Python
negative_examples: What is photosynthesis?
fix this bug
write a function that reverses a list

intents.label: refactor or convert code
intents.description: Refactor, optimize, clean up, or convert existing code to another language or style.
examples: Refactor this function to be more readable
optimize this SQL query for speed
convert this JavaScript code to TypeScript
rewrite this loop using list comprehension
clean up this class and remove duplication
port this Python 2 code to Python 3
add type hints to this module
negative_examples: rewrite this paragraph to sound formal
why does this code crash

intents.label: fix a device, app or account problem
intents.description: Help with a problem in a device, app, internet connection or online account (not source code).
examples: laptop won't turn on after the update
printer says offline but it's connected
my phone battery drains really fast
I can't log into my email account
the app crashes when I upload a photo
bluetooth headphones won't pair with my laptop
my computer has become very slow lately
the microphone isn't picking up my voice on calls
my smartwatch stopped syncing with my phone
negative_examples: my Python script throws a KeyError
find a new laptop under 50000

intents.label: make a plan or itinerary
intents.description: Create a plan, itinerary, schedule, roadmap or step-by-step program.
examples: make a study timetable for my exams next month
create a workout plan for beginners
I want to organize a birthday party for 20 people, help me plan
what should my roadmap be to learn data science in 6 months
plan a budget-friendly weekend in Jaipur
give me a step-by-step plan to launch my online store
draw up a meal plan for weight loss
negative_examples: remind me to call mom at 6 pm
book a flight to Goa

intents.label: set a reminder or schedule an event
intents.description: Create a reminder, alarm, meeting or calendar event at a date or time.
examples: Remind me to call mom at 6 pm
schedule a meeting with the design team tomorrow at 10am
set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning
add dentist appointment on Friday at 4pm to my calendar
set up a call with Rahul next Monday
create a reminder to pay rent on the 1st
put a team standup every weekday at 9:30
don't let me forget to submit the report by Thursday
nudge me at 5 to leave for the gym
alert me on Friday about the car service
negative_examples: plan my week
show my calendar for tomorrow
